plans.executive_summary: Incident inc-001 details a critical compromise of the SSH server (ssh-src / 10.0.0.10) originating from external IP 203.0.113.75. The attack began with port reconnaissance (T1595.001), followed by brute-force authentication against the deploy user (T1110), unauthorized privilege escalation via sudo to obtain a root shell (T1548.003), and subsequent data exfiltration of approximately 150MB over a non-standard port 4444 to an external destination (T1041). Targeted containment, thorough investigation, and strict preventive controls are required.

immediate_actions.action: Block attacker IP address on perimeter firewall
Isolate compromised host from internal network
Terminate active sessions and disable compromised deploy user account temporarily

investigation_steps: Review SSH authentication logs on ssh-srv around 2026-10-16T20:37:10Z through 21:07:10Z to trace exact command execution history.
Inspect sudoers configuration and auth logs to verify the scope of the privilege escalation.
Examine network flow logs and firewall records to identify the exact destination IP and amount of data exfiltrated on port 4444.
Check for unauthorized persistence mechanisms (cron jobs, authorized_keys modifications, backdoors) on ssh-srv.
prevention: Enforce multi-factor authentication for all SSH and remote administrative access.
Implement account lockout policies and rate-limiting for SSH login attempts to mitigate brute-force and credential spraying.
Audit and restrict sudo privileges, ensuring least privilege principles are applied to service and deployment accounts.
Configure strict egress filtering and network intrusion detection systems to alert on and block unauthorized outbound data transfers on non-standard ports.
